out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. OBSERVED NO HANDWASHING SOAP AVAILABLE AT HANDWASHING SINK AT BAR.
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. CDI: SOAP PROVIDED TO SINK DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. OBSERVED NO HAND DRYING PROVISION AVAILABLE AT HANDWASHING SINK AT BAR.
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. CDI: PAPER TOWELS PROVIDED DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: OBSERVED RAW FISH AND RAW SHRIMP ON A SHELF ABOVE COOKED CHICKEN IN THE TWO-DOOR STAND-UP COOLER
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. CDI: COOKED CHICKEN MOVED TO A SHELF ABOVE THE RAW SHRIMP AND FISH.

violations.title: Before Use After Cleaning
violations.observation: The food-contact surfaces of the following equipment were not observed sanitized: CUPS, EATING UTENSILS, PLATES OBSERVED THE ABOVE DISHWARE RUN THROUGH THE DISHWASHER THAT WAS NOT SANITIZING.
violations.corrective_action: All utensils and food-contact surfaces of equipment shall be sanitized before use and after cleaning. CDI: FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES WERE WASHED, RINSED, AND SANITIZED IN THE THREE-VAT SINK.

violations.title: Food Protection Manager - Accredited Program
violations.observation: It shall be unlawful to operate a food establishment unless it is under the immediate control of a certified food manager who has shown proficiency through passing an accredited examination. UPON ARRIVAL NO CFM WAS PRESENT IN FACILITY WHILE FACILITY WAS OPERATING.
violations.corrective_action: Obtain a certified food managers certificate from an accredited program. CDI: CFM ARRIVED DURING INSPECTION. EHS RECOMMENDED HAVING ANOTHER EMPLOYEE TAKE CFM CLASS.

violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the BAR being used FOR DUMPING ICE AND STORING OF CHEMICALS AND OTHER VARIOUS BOTTLES.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CDI: PIC RE-EDUCATED ON THE USEAGE OF THE HANDWASHING SINK. BABYLON FUTBOL CAFE (Inspection Date: 07/28/2025) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Cold Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed cold holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: IN TWO-DOOR STAND-UP COOLER: EGG ROLLS AT 45.1F, COOKED VEGETABLES AT 45.6F, AND COOKED CHICKEN AT 45.4F. IN THREE-DOOR PREPP-TOP: SALSA AT 51F, COOKED RICE AT 52.6F. PIC/WORKER STATED ALL FOOD WAS PLACED IN COOLERS ONE HOUR PRIOR.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. CDI: PIC/WORKER DIRECTED TO PLACE ALL TCS FOODS IN THE WALK-IN COOLER AND NOT TO UTILIZE THESE UNITS UNTIL THEY ARE WORKING AS REQUIRED (HOLDING FOODS AT 41F OR BELOW)

violations.title: Proper thawing methods used for TCS Foods
violations.observation: Observed the following food thawing using an improper method: OBSERVED PARTIALLY FROZEN CHICKEN STORED ON THREE-VAT SINK AT ROOM TEMPERATURE, NOT IN USE.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be thawed using one of the following methods: 1) under refrigeration that maintains the food temperature at 41F or less, 2) completely submerged under running water at a water temperature of 70F or below with a sufficient velocity to agitate and float off loose particles of food as long as held for period of time at a temperature of 41F or less, or 3) as part of a cooking process if the food is cooked as specified by Law or thawed in a microwave oven and immediately transferred to a conventional cooking process.

out_items.name: Insects, rodents, and animals not present

violations.title: Openings Protected from Pest Entry
violations.observation: Window or door is kept open for ventilation and opening is not protected by a screen or other effective means. OBSERVED BOTH BACK DOORS IN KITCHEN KEPT WIDE OPEN DURING INSPECTION.
violations.corrective_action: Provide screens (16 mesh to 1 inch), air curtains, or other effective means to protect against the entry of insects and rodents. CDI: EHS DIRECTED EMPLOYEES TO CLOSE THE DOORS.

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Ice As Coolant Not Used as Food
violations.observation: Ice used as a medium for cooling the exterior surfaces of food is also for beverage ice or used as food. OBSERVED ICE FOR DRINKS AT BAR WITH METAL DRINK MIXER INSIDE.
violations.corrective_action: After use as a medium for cooling the exterior surfaces of food, packaged foods, beverages, or cooling coils/tubes, the ice may not be used as food. CDI: ICE DRAINED. PLEASE DO NOT STORE ITEMS INSIDE OF ICE USED AS FOOD.

violations.title: Linens & Napkins, Proper Use
violations.observation: Linens (i.e. napkins, aprons, towels, table cloths) found used in direct contact with the following food item(s): OBSERVED WASH CLOTHS ON TOP OF EGG ROLLS IN TWO-DOOR STAND-UP IN KITCHEN.
violations.corrective_action: Linens may not be used in contact with food unless they are used to line a container for the service of foods and the linens are replaced each time the container is refilled for a new consumer. CDI: CFM REMOVED WASH CLOTHS DURING INSPECTION.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: chicken wings, beans and cooked pasta in the walk in cooler and 2 dr upright refrigerators
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. EMPLOYEE ADDED DATES TO FOOD.
